Incrementally lint only added or modified lines in a Git diff / pull request

Source: R/lint-diff.R
stat_lint_diff.Rd

Enables adopting statci in continuous integration on large legacy repositories without failing on untouched historical code. Parses either a supplied unified diff (diff_text) or invokes safe read-only git diff against a strictly validated base_ref, runs full-file AST analysis on each modified .R/.qmd/.Rmd file (preserving cross-line and cross-chunk context such as upstream set.seed() calls), and reports only findings landing on added or modified lines.

Usage

stat_lint_diff(
  path = ".",
  base_ref = "HEAD",
  head_ref = NULL,
  diff_text = NULL,
  staged = FALSE,
  rules = NULL,
  exclude_rules = NULL,
  skip_eval_false = FALSE,
  pattern = "\\.(R|r|qmd|Rmd|rmd)$"
)

Arguments

path

Root repository or project directory (default ".").

base_ref

Git base reference (e.g., "HEAD", "main", "HEAD~1", or commit SHA) used when diff_text is NULL and staged = FALSE.

head_ref

Optional Git head reference for two-ref diffs (e.g., base_ref = "main", head_ref = "HEAD"). When NULL (default), diffs base_ref against the current working tree.

diff_text

Optional character scalar or vector containing unified diff output (git diff -U0 or diff -u). When provided, git is not invoked.

staged

Logical; if TRUE (and diff_text is NULL), runs git diff --cached against staged index changes. Default FALSE.

rules

Optional subset of lint rules (forwarded to stat_lint()).

exclude_rules

Optional character vector of rule IDs to skip.

skip_eval_false

Logical; for .qmd/.Rmd files, skip eval = FALSE chunks. Default FALSE.

pattern

Regular expression matching lintable files (defaults to "\\.(R|r|qmd|Rmd|rmd)$").

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_lint" (compatible with statci_report(), render_statci_report(), export_statci_sarif(), and statci_check_gate()) with an additional $diff_meta list recording changed_files, changed_lines, and n_suppressed_untouched.

Details

All Git refs are strictly validated against option injection (leading -, control bytes, shell characters), and all diff file paths are strictly confined inside path (blocking .. path traversal and symlink escapes).

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("statci_diff_")
dir.create(tmp)
script <- file.path(tmp, "legacy.R")
writeLines(c(
  "legacy_x <- rnorm(10)",
  "set.seed(42)",
  "new_val <- mean(rnorm(5), na.rm = T)"
), script)
diff_u <- paste(
  "--- a/legacy.R",
  "+++ b/legacy.R",
  "@ -2,0 +3,1 @",
  "+new_val <- mean(rnorm(5), na.rm = T)",
  sep = "\n"
)
# Line 1 (legacy unseeded rnorm) is untouched and ignored; only line 3 is flagged!
res <- stat_lint_diff(path = tmp, diff_text = diff_u)
res
#> [PASS] statci lint: 0 file(s), 20 rule(s) | 0 error(s), 0 warning(s), 0 info
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
